verdict.rationale: Gitea is a self-hosted Git service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is an applicable axis. A probe confirms an official MCP server, gitea-mcp, published under the first-party gitea organization, so an agent can connect to Gitea through it. The evidence is a single probe hit with no detail on tools, setup or behaviour. Missing for 10: documented tool/resource coverage, setup and authentication instructions, transport details, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connectivity.
